import cache
import service

def test_make_key_different_inputs():
    # Test that different inputs produce different keys
    key1 = cache.make_key('text1', 'profile1', 'criteria1')
    key2 = cache.make_key('text1', 'profile1', 'criteria2')
    key3 = cache.make_key('text1', 'profile2', 'criteria1')
    key4 = cache.make_key('text2', 'profile1', 'criteria1')
    
    assert key1 != key2, "Different criteria should produce different keys"
    assert key1 != key3, "Different profile should produce different keys"
    assert key1 != key4, "Different text should produce different keys"
    
    # Test that same inputs produce same key
    key5 = cache.make_key('text1', 'profile1', 'criteria1')
    assert key1 == key5, "Same inputs should produce same key"

def test_cache_reuse():
    # Test that unchanged inputs reuse cached value even with None
    store = {}
    
    compute_called = [False]
    def compute1():
        compute_called[0] = True
        return 'result1'
    
    def compute2():
        compute_called[0] = True
        return 'result2'
    
    # First call - should compute
    result1 = service.score(store, 'text1', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute1)
    assert result1 == 'result1', "First call should use compute1"
    assert compute_called[0] == True, "Compute should be called on first access"
    
    # Second call with same inputs - should reuse
    compute_called[0] = False
    result2 = service.score(store, 'text1', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute2)
    assert result2 == 'result1', "Second call should reuse cached value"
    assert compute_called[0] == False, "Compute should not be called on second access with same inputs"

def test_cache_invalidates_on_any_change():
    # Test that changing any input invalidates cache
    store = {}
    
    # First call
    result1 = service.score(store, 'text1', 'profile1', 'criteria1', lambda: 'result1')
    assert result1 == 'result1'
    
    # Change text - should recompute
    compute_called = False
    def compute2():
        nonlocal compute_called
        compute_called = True
        return 'result2'
    
    compute_called = False
    result2 = service.score(store, 'text2', 'profile1', 'criteria1', compute2)
    assert result2 == 'result2', "Changing text should recompute"
    assert compute_called == True, "Compute should be called after changing text"
    
    # Change profile - should recompute
    compute_called = False
    result3 = service.score(store, 'text1', 'profile2', 'criteria1', lambda: 'result3')
    assert result3 == 'result3', "Changing profile should recompute"
    
    # Change criteria - should recompute
    compute_called = False
    result4 = service.score(store, 'text1', 'profile1', 'criteria2', lambda: 'result4')
    assert result4 == 'result4', "Changing criteria should recompute"

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_make_key_different_inputs()
    print('test_make_key_different_inputs passed')
    
    test_cache_reuse()
    print('test_cache_reuse passed')
    
    test_cache_invalidates_on_any_change()
    print('test_cache_invalidates_on_any_change passed')
    
    print('All tests passed!')
